title: Global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs outside the US
summary: Jake Barber tells of Global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs outside the US, about present at worldwide, outside the US, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there are there are global crash recovery and reverse engineering programs um outside the US.

plain: Jake Barber, who says he once flew a helicopter to retrieve a UFO, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that the US is not the only country doing this kind of work. He says there are programmes around the world that recover crashed craft and try to reverse engineer them, meaning take them apart to learn how to copy the technology. If true, the race to understand such craft would be global.
